source.name: DummyJSON
source.purpose: Public fake/placeholder API for development, testing, and prototyping.
source.imageLicense: The checked public pages do not specify an image reuse/stock-photo license. Free API access is not evidence of copyright, trademark, endorsement, or commercial image clearance. Demo use only; verify rights before production reuse.
source.privacy: Only fictional reviewer names, ratings, comments, and dates supplied by the demo dataset are retained. Reviewer emails and other provider metadata are excluded.
source.verificationLimit: Contact sheets verify visual item/title consistency and source mapping, not manufacturer identity, technical claims, materials, warranties, or image copyright. Some source images look like product renderings rather than camera photographs.

visualAudit.method: Read tool inspection of eight category contact sheets, including every original angle and thumbnail.

excludedCandidates.title: Marni Red & Black Suit
excludedCandidates.reason: Image depicts a single dress, not an unmistakable suit; replaced rather than rewriting the source title.

excludedCandidates.title: Samsung Galaxy S10
excludedCandidates.reason: Front and rear phone model details appeared potentially inconsistent; replaced conservatively.

transformations.prices: Original USD price rounded to integer cents; compare_at_price is null (no invented reference prices).
transformations.brands: Original brand verbatim; missing source brands are displayed as Not specified, never inferred from packaging or titles.
transformations.reviews: Exactly the three source demo reviews; rating is their arithmetic mean rounded to two decimals, not the provider aggregate rating.
transformations.stock: Source stock capped at 25; allocated across demo variants without multiplying stock.
transformations.variants: Demo-only S/M/L for clothing; Standard/Gift-ready packaging elsewhere, the latter +300 cents. Sizes/packaging are not claims of source availability.
transformations.delivery: Upper bound of source shipping estimate; a week is 7 days and a month is 30 days. Original shipping wording is retained in features.
transformations.features: Verbatim description, warranty, and shipping information; no invented technical specifications.
transformations.photos: Original source WebP bytes downloaded unchanged, including every original angle and a separate thumbnail. SHA-256 hashes record their identity.
transformations.color: Only visually verified single colors are assigned; ambiguous, multicolor, and cosmetic products use Mixed. No color variants are invented.
transformations.display: The parent UI must label the catalog, prices, brands, reviews, and checkout as demo data; these are not live retail offers or endorsements.
